name: Yagura Kaori
source:
[b]Workplace:[/b] Queen
[b]Favorite tea:[/b] Russian Tea
[b]Hobby:[/b] Coordinating other people's clothes

A young lady from a good family working at Queen. She considers everything that happens outside her home to be part of her bridal training. She became friends with Ling through the events of the first Djungarian game. Although she is engaged to a wealthy young man, she continues to work her part-time job.
